- (a) The principal of the Bonds is subject to prepayment without penalty at any time, at the option of the Town either in whole or in part, from money in Sinking Fund No. 2 not required for paying the principal of and interest on the Bonds coming due in the then current sinking fund year and not required for creating and currently maintaining at the required level of deposit a reserve in said fund in the amount hereinafter provided or in such larger amount as may be required in any future ordinance authorizing the issuance of future parity bonds, or from any money which may be available for such purpose on, or before the date fixed for payment.

- (b) In the event parity bonds are hereafter issued, neither the Bonds nor any such parity bonds may be prepaid or redeemed in part unless and until Sinking Fund No. 2 is at its proper balance and there shall exist no default in the payment of the principal and interest on the Bonds or any series of parity bonds then outstanding; provided, however, that the Town shall have the right to acquire as a whole, by prepayment, redemption or otherwise, all outstanding bonds of all parity issues from any funds which may be available for that purpose.

- (c) At least thirty days before any date upon which any such prepayment or redemption is to be made, a notice of intention so to prepay or redeem, designating the prepayment or redemption date and the series and amount of the Bonds to be prepaid or redeemed, signed by the Mayor of the Town, shall be mailed, postage prepaid, to the registered owner of the Bonds to be prepaid or redeemed at the address of such registered owner as the same shall appear upon the books of registration.

- (d) Prepayment of the Bonds under this Article shall be made by the payment of the principal amount of the Bond or Bonds to be prepaid plus accrued interest thereon to the date fixed for prepayment, without penalty or premium.

- (e) Should future parity bonds hereafter be issued pursuant to and in accordance with authority therefor herein contained, the bonds of any such future issue or issues may be prepaid or redeemed in whole or in part before the Bonds are prepaid or the Bonds may be prepaid in whole or in part before the redemption of any bonds of any such future series or the Bonds may be prepaid, in whole or in part, and some of the bonds from any such future series may be redeemed at the same time, subject to Sinking Fund No. 2 requirements prescribed by the provisions of this Article.
3: in the manner and under the terms and conditions hereinabove provided, the Bonds shall, on the prepayment date designated in such notice, become and be due and payable to the extent of the principal amount to be prepaid and interest on such amount shall, after the giving of such notice, cease to accrue from and after the date fixed for prepayment unless default shall be made in prepayment upon presentation of said Bond. Any such prepayment in part shall not affect, prior to the payment of the entire principal balance, the amount or payment date of any monthly installment, but shall be applied against the principal portion of the monthly instaliment or installments next due, which may shorten the final maturity of the Bonds.
